title: Getting from one hold to the Kingswood required finding a specific unnamed room ('The High Cut') off the Iron Downs' spoil maze that isn't named in any NPC dialogue or quest text I encountered -- it was found purely by brute-force compass exploration, which is the single most 'lost' I felt in the whole run.
